programme.title: S01 : E04 German Touring Car Championship 1992 - Classic Races
programme.desc: The Deutsche Tourenwagen Meisterschaft was one of the most important racing series in German motorsports. It was difficult, tough and well-known for its die-hard battles between the international competitors. We present the highlights of the 1992 race.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Ferry Porsche - Motorheads
programme.desc: After the Second World War, following in his father's footsteps who had been responsible for the development of the classic Volkswagen, Ferry Porsche laid the foundation for the brand's sports car models like the 356 and later the Porsche 911.

programme.title: S01 : E03 Walter Röhrl - Motorheads
programme.desc: One cannot talk about rally sports without mentioning the name Walter Röhrl. From an early age, Röhrl showed his talent in rally sports and won the European, World and other international rally championships several times in his career.

programme.title: S01 : E11 Audi Quattro - Triumph of an Idea, 1980 - Classic Races
programme.desc: With the launch of the four-wheel drive 4WD in 1980, Audi changed the rally world. The company's advanced engineering not only improved the handling of the rally cars, but also confronted the drivers with new challenges.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Amphicar 770 - Classic Ride
programme.desc: The Amphicar 770 is a rare classic and a unique vehicle. It may not be the fastest car on the street, but it’s ready to be used on the water as well and drives like a motorboat.

programme.title: S01 : E02 MG TC - Classic Ride
programme.desc: The MG TC is a sporty, but also extremely spartan car with technology from the late 1940s. We accompanied the owner of a MG TC on his way to pass the TÜV, the German technical certification test.

programme.title: S03 : E62 Auction Classics - Classic Ride
programme.desc: Obecnie klasyczny DeLorean z otwieranymi do góry drzwiami to inwestycja motoryzacyjna. W ofercie: 100 wymarzonych samochodów na aukcji klasycznych samochodów w Szwajcarii. A także nowoczesne klasyki z potencjałem inwestycyjnym, takie jak Mercedes 190E 2.3 16V.

programme.title: S02 : E41 Vintage Cars Worldwide - Classic Ride
programme.desc: In Thailand a Mercedes 190 SL and other souped-up classics take part in the Bangkok Classic Car Ride. Plus: an Oldsmobile convertible on Venezuela's most beautiful island. And: classic cars from the US as a tourist attraction in Cuba.

programme.title: S01 : E12 Animal-like Cars - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: In Los Angeles, Dean Malay put the Hollywood appeal of the Volkswagen Beetle Convertible to the test. Also: at the BMW Design Night the Bavarian manufacturer showcased its newest creations. And: the Stuck brothers with the Lexus IS-F at the test track.

programme.title: S01 : E07 To the Top! - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: The Audi Sport Quattro S1 was a rally legend. We checked how the company's series vehicle A1 Quattro fares in comparison. Also: the Stuck brothers take the Ford Focus ST to the test track. And: the spacey, but cute electric microcar Renault Twizy.

programme.title: S01 : E33 Pickups - 4x4
programme.desc: In Europe pickups are mainly used commercially. In the US these trucks are as common as SUVs. We compared the Volkswagen Amarok to the Toyota Hilux. Also: current US pickups, the Chevrolet Colorado and GMC's Sierra and Canyon.

programme.title: S01 : E24 Tuned SUVs - 4x4
programme.desc: SUVs usually are rather impressive right out of the factory, but there are many tuning and customizing options. In this episode we present Kelleners BMW X5, the Mercedes Brabus B63 and the Porsche Cayenne tuned by Techart.

programme.title: S01 : E33 Eurocopter - Made in ...
programme.desc: The Eurocopter EC 135 is the most successful and best-selling helicopter in the world and a multi-talent. Whether as a VIP shuttle, in air rescue or for the police. This all-rounder is even used for military tasks.

programme.title: S01 : E23 Unimog - Made in ...
programme.desc: It is a synonym and a touchstone for four-wheel drive movement. It is the symbol for quality of commercial vehicle constructions worldwide. Mercedes-Benz manufactured for the 60th birthday a new Unimog.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Ferruccio Lamborghini - Motorheads
programme.desc: In 1964, Ferruccio Lamborghini set himself the goal to build the best sports cars in the world, a bold move, being located only a few kilometers from Ferrari.

programme.title: S01 : E06 Alois Ruf - Motorheads
programme.desc: Alois Ruf is the founder of a small, but well-known car manufacturing company in Bavaria that specialises in building their own vision of street legal super sports cars on the foundation of Porsche bodys.

programme.title: S01 : E35 Offroad Minis - 4x4
programme.desc: Small 4x4's are on the rise, as it doesn't need to be size that matters when it comes to having fun in the city or off-road. We take a look at mini SUVs, the Fiat's 500 X, the Cross Polo and Cross up! by Volkswagen and BMW's X1 XDrive.

programme.title: S01 : E18 Land Rover Special - 4x4
programme.desc: The Land Rover Defender is one of the oldest offroad car models. We took a look at this iconic vehicle and 70 years of Land Rover history. Also: we took the Range Rover Evoque, the most recent model of the British brand, to the legendary Silk Road.

programme.title: S02 : E47 Close to the ground - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: In their 4 series BMW took into account that sporty vehicles need a low center of gravity. In the manufacturer's range of vehicles this model is closest to the asphalt. We compared the BMW 435i and Porsche's Cayman S and took a look at the Alfa Romeo 4C.

programme.title: S02 : E49 Athletes on stilts - Power SUVs - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: Since the rising popularity of SUVs compact models have become a new trend, so the manufacturers started offering more models and pushing their performance. We took a look at the competitors Audi RS Q3, Mercedes-AMG GLA 45 and Porsche Macan Turbo.

programme.title: S01 : E32 Stereotypes on Two Wheels - Motocicletas
programme.desc: Skutery, stereotypy na dwóch kółkach? Nie zawsze musi to być klasyczna Vespa! Przyglądamy się trzem alternatywom: dużemu skuterowi Kymco xciting 500 i, który przypomina jazdę na sofie, trójkołowemu skuterowi Piaggio MP3 500 z dwoma przednimi kołami, który obiecuje więcej dynamicznej przyjemności z jazdy oraz mocnemu elektrycznemu skuterowi e-max z Chin.

programme.title: S01 : E38 Trikes - Motocicletas
programme.desc: Whether taking it easy and cruising, or firing it up and drifting - trikes, scooters and three-wheeled bike conversions all have their own charm and driving dynamics, especially the trikes. We take a closer look at four rather exotic motorcycles: the Rewaco RF1 Turbo, Piaggio's MP3 and bike conversions for the Suzuki 800 Intruder and the Triumph Rocket III Touring.

programme.title: S03 : E152 La Dolce Vita - Supercoches
programme.desc: With the Alfieri, Maserati in 2014 celebrated their anniversary with the introduction of a beautiful grand tourer. In remembrance and as part of the three-day celebration, Maserati organised a cruise from Bologna to Torino with some of their most iconic cars.

programme.title: S01 : E19 Fiat Dino - Classic Ride
programme.desc: The Fiat Dino Spider is one of the most beautiful cabriolets of the 1960s. Its impeccable design was created by Pininfarina, and only 525 units were built. Under its hood growls a Ferrari V6 engine.

programme.title: S02 : E45 50 Years Corvette Stingray - Classic Ride
programme.desc: 1963 saw the launch of the Chevrolet Corvette Stingray, the brand's answer to established sports car models by Jaguar, Maserati and others. Many consider it to be the most exciting sports car of all time. We pay tribute to this classic.

programme.title: S02 : E34 The Advantages of All-wheel Drive - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: We took the all-wheel model of the Mazda CX-5 off the road in order to test its terrain capabilities. In addition: what does the third generation of BMW's so-called SAV X5 have to offer? And: Kia's compact SUV, the Sportage.

programme.title: S03 : E60 Typically German - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: What are the characteristics of a typical German car? Do stereotypes like functionality, reliability but also a certain dullness paint a realistic picture? Also, we explored if the Volkswagen Golf GTE could bring new impulses to the brand's model range.

programme.title: S02 : E118 Batman's Dreams: Supercars in Acceleration - Supercoches
programme.desc: The clash of the convertibles, the Nissan 370 Z in comparison to Porsche's Boxster S. Also: the exclusive one-off high-performance sports car Maybach Exelero. And: a dream of a sports car, a vehicle of superlatives, the Bugatti Veyron Vitesse.

programme.title: S02 : E129 Jaguar F-Type - Supercoches
programme.desc: Jaguar found their way back to the world of sports cars. The F-Type is able to take on the competition like the BMW Z4. We also took a closer look at two other competitors, the Porsche Boxster S and Nissan's 370 Z.

programme.title: S01 : E10 The Ten Most Fuel-efficient Cars - Top 10 Show
programme.desc: Nie każdy może pozwolić sobie na wydawanie ogromnych sum pieniędzy na paliwo. Prezentujemy naszą dziesiątkę najbardziej oszczędnych samochodów pod względem zużycia paliwa.

programme.title: S01 : E30 The Best Beastly Car Names - Top 10 Show
programme.desc: Car models are named after all sorts of things, from countries to ancient deities to animals. We take a look at the top 10 cars named after animals.

programme.title: S01 : E09 The Ambulance - Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Stunt coordinator Domi’s latest idea for the Stunt Heroes team involves an old ambulance that is prepared so that the stuntman can jump right through the ambulance with his car.

programme.title: S01 : E11 The Pile-Up - Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Fog, darkness and a pileup involving multiple cars, the Stunt Heroes want to recreate such a scene as part of a stunt with burning people, a fireman who arrives late at the scene and a car that flies through the air.

programme.title: S02 : E129 Jaguar F-Type - Supercoches
programme.desc: Jaguar found their way back to the world of sports cars. The F-Type is able to take on the competition like the BMW Z4. We also took a closer look at two other competitors, the Porsche Boxster S and Nissan's 370 Z.

programme.title: S03 : E173 Maserati Ghibli - Supercoches
programme.desc: With the Ghibli, Maserati advanced into a more affordable market segment. But the competition is strong. In addition: taking the Maserati GranCabrio MC on a cruise through the Alps.

programme.title: S01 : E38 The Most Beautiful Vintage Cars - Top 10 Show
programme.desc: There are classic cars that are undisputed beauties when it comes to design and look. We take a look at our top 10 most beautiful classic cars.

programme.title: S01 : E13 The Most Successful Cars in the 24h Race - Top 10 Show
programme.desc: 24-hour races are one of the toughest tests for man and machine in motor racing. We present the most successful cars in this racing category in our Top 10 list.

programme.title: S02 : E117 Million-Dollar Toys from the Middle East - Supercoches
programme.desc: The McLaren MP4 12C Spider, one of many high-performance sports cars featured at the Doha Motor Show in Qatar. Also: the creations of manufacturers like Lamborghini, Bertone or Porsche but also the first Arab super sports car, the Lykan HyperSport.

programme.title: S01 : E94 Audi at Le Mans - Supercoches
programme.desc: At the 2012 Le Mans 24 Hours, Audi entered the R18 e-tron quattro for the first time. Also: the Porsche Cayenne GTS, the model between the S and the Turbo. And: the Mercedes-Benz CLS Shooting Brake.

programme.title: S02 : E54 Sporty Fords - Classic Ride
programme.desc: The 1955 Ford Thunderbird is part of Henry Ford's motorsports legacy. In addition: the Ford Capri from the May car tuning company is as fast as a 1970s Porsche. And: the Ford Mustang, the progenitor of the so-called pony car.

programme.title: S02 : E104 Lamborghini - Supercoches
programme.desc: Sant'Agata Bolognese, the home of the iconic Italian sports car manufacturer Lamborghini, is the perfect place to take a look under the hood of the different Gallardo models. Also: cruising through Rome in an Aventador LP700-4.

programme.title: S02 : E38 Scrapyard Gold - Classic Ride
programme.desc: It is not too unusual to find hidden gems of automotive history in a perfect condition in barns or scrap yards. Also: the MGC GT Sebring, that was built for the 12 Hours of Sebring race.

programme.title: S03 : E71 Mobility in Eastern Europe - Classic Ride
programme.desc: In the 1950s, companies like Tatra from Czechoslovakia introduced advanced, even pioneering automobiles. The clientele was exclusive, which is why now these streamlined cars are big rarities. We tracked down the owner of a 1937 Tatra T87.

programme.title: S02 : E51 Open Air Concert - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: As an homage to driving top-down we took a look at three of the most beautiful convertibles. The animalistic sound of the Audi S3 convertible's 4-cylinder is astonishing. But what about the Nissan 370 Z Roadster? Or Porsche's Boxster GTS?

programme.title: S01 : E17 Topless on the road - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: Convertibles suggest to the feeling of freedom while driving a car. We took a look at what Opel's Cascada and Adam convertible models had to offer. Also: what does the BMW 3 series Gran Turismo have in common with its bigger brother from the 5 series?

programme.title: S02 : E124 Special: 24h of Le Mans - Track Days - Supercoches
programme.desc: Dwa tygodnie przed rozpoczęciem 24 godzin Le Mans, wszystkie zespoły są zajęte testowaniem swoich samochodów na tradycyjnym torze długodystansowym we Francji. Zła pogoda, wypadki i duże napięcie - udokumentowaliśmy oficjalne dni testowe w 2013 roku.

programme.title: S03 : E190 V8 Power - Supercoches
programme.desc: Przyjrzeliśmy się pierwszemu kabrioletowi marki Mercedes-Benz w serii S. Ponadto: z okazji 50-lecia Chevroleta Camaro w 2016 roku marka wydała szóstą generację swojego klasyka. A także: górska przejażdżka kabrioletem Corvette C7.

programme.title: S01 : E12 Episode 12 - Trackmasters
programme.desc: Once again it was time for the VLN Endurance Racing Championship. While the drivers were doing their test laps, we had a look behind the scenes and explored what went on in the pit lanes.

programme.title: S01 : E16 Episode 16 - Trackmasters
programme.desc: In this episode we invite you to witness the progress of driver Uwe Nittle as he got ready for qualifying at the Truck Grand Prix.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Chevy Camaro vs Mercedes SLS AMG - Pon tu coche en TV
programme.desc: Mylene Gomera and Saif Hattawi invite car freaks from the Middle East to show off their souped-up vehicles on the "Walk" at Jumeirah Beach in Dubai. In this episode, a Chevrolet Camaro competes against a Mercedes SLS AMG.

programme.title: S01 : E02 BMW X5 vs Mercedes SLK 230 - Pon tu coche en TV
programme.desc: If you like souped-up and luxuriously equipped vehicles, Jumeirah Beach in Dubai is the place to be. There, the cars are judged and there is also something to win. This episode features a BMW X5 and a Mercedes SLK 230.

programme.title: S03 : E160 Road Stars - Supercoches
programme.desc: The Silvretta Hochalpenstrasse in Austria is the ideal playground for the lightweight power packs Lotus Elise and Roding Roadster. Also: the elegant but still very powerful Porsche 911 Targa 4S.

programme.title: S02 : E106 Porsche to the Max - Supercoches
programme.desc: The Techart Grand GT by Porsche's house tuner is a souped-up Panamera. But the off-the-shelf GTS model also has its treats. Patrick Simon took this monster to the track. In addition: Ruf's anniversary model RT 35. And: the 911 Carrera 4.

programme.title: S01 : E05 BMW X6M vs Nissan Patrol - Pon tu coche en TV
programme.desc: At Jumeirah Beach in Dubai, car owners can have their souped-up vehicles judged in three categories and win an overnight stay at the Sofitel Hotel. This time, a BMW X6M, a Ford F250 and a Nissan Patrol are in the running.

programme.title: S01 : E03 Nova SS vs Honda Accord - Pon tu coche en TV
programme.desc: On Put Your Car On TV, car fans from the Middle East can have their darlings rated in terms of speed, style and sound. Included this time: a Nova SS, a special Honda Accord and a car clad in crystals.

programme.title: S01 : E15 Episode 15 - Trackmasters
programme.desc: We present the highlights of last week. The 24 hour race was exciting, as usual. In addition, we explored the 'Strong Man Run' and took a look at the tourist drivers

programme.title: S01 : E12 Episode 12 - Trackmasters
programme.desc: Once again it was time for the VLN Endurance Racing Championship. While the drivers were doing their test laps, we had a look behind the scenes and explored what went on in the pit lanes.

programme.title: S01 : E26 Porsche Special - Classic Ride
programme.desc: Porsche is a world-famous brand and a household name when it comes to sports cars. For over 70 years fans have been attracted to Porsche automobiles. But when was the big rise of the brand and when was their first car created?

programme.title: S03 : E66 Space Savers - Classic Ride
programme.desc: The Volkswagen Samba transforms from pack mule into high-priced classic. And: a former letter box with 37 seats. The 1962 'Graf and Stift' post bus now takes tourists to their hotel.

programme.title: S01 : E10 Changing the model - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: BMW got into the electric mobility business with their ActiveE and i3 models. We visited the company's technology office in Silicon Valley. Also: the Stuck brothers at the test track with the Mercedes C 63 AMG. And: the Audi A3 Sportback.

programme.title: S02 : E52 The big journey - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: The Mercedes-AMG E63 S is a wolf in sheep's clothing. This station wagon has more power than the Nissan GTR 'Godzilla'. Also: the Porsche Panamera GTS feels at home on the motorway and on the race track. And: Audi's powerful all-purpose executive car RS6.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Pikes Peak - Classic Races
programme.desc: The Pikes Peak Hill Climb is a rather unique type of car race in the mountains of Colorado, USA. It's exciting, tough and dangerous, and in 1987, two-time world rally champion Walter Roehrl took his Audi Sport Quattro S1 to the top.

programme.title: S01 : E16 Rally Sport 1983 - Classic Races
programme.desc: In 1983 Audi introduced the Quattro 4x4 drive to the rally world, adding a new dimension to rally racing. The races became tougher and more brutal. The strain on drivers, vehicles and mechanics alike was extremely intense.

programme.title: S02 : E38 Scrapyard Gold - Classic Ride
programme.desc: It is not too unusual to find hidden gems of automotive history in a perfect condition in barns or scrap yards. Also: the MGC GT Sebring, that was built for the 12 Hours of Sebring race.

programme.title: S02 : E47 British Sportscar Rarities - Classic Ride
programme.desc: In the early 20th century people used to travel in vehicles like the Morgan Threewheeler, a mixture between motorcycle and car, thus avoiding the British tax on cars. We got hold of a 1936 Morgan Threewheeler and went for a ride.

programme.title: S01 : E15 Le Mans 1952 - Classic Races
programme.desc: The year 1952 saw several premieres at the legendary 24-hour endurance race of Le Mans. After 22 years Mercedes-Benz returned to the famous circuit, and Ferrari started to use factory works team cars for the first time.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Ferruccio Lamborghini - Motorheads
programme.desc: In 1964, Ferruccio Lamborghini set himself the goal to build the best sports cars in the world, a bold move, being located only a few kilometers from Ferrari.

programme.title: S01 : E03 Walter Röhrl - Motorheads
programme.desc: One cannot talk about rally sports without mentioning the name Walter Röhrl. From an early age, Röhrl showed his talent in rally sports and won the European, World and other international rally championships several times in his career.

programme.title: S01 : E04 German Touring Car Championship 1992 - Classic Races
programme.desc: The Deutsche Tourenwagen Meisterschaft was one of the most important racing series in German motorsports. It was difficult, tough and well-known for its die-hard battles between the international competitors. We present the highlights of the 1992 race.

programme.title: S01 : E11 Audi Quattro - Triumph of an Idea, 1980 - Classic Races
programme.desc: With the launch of the four-wheel drive 4WD in 1980, Audi changed the rally world. The company's advanced engineering not only improved the handling of the rally cars, but also confronted the drivers with new challenges.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Amphicar 770 - Classic Ride
programme.desc: The Amphicar 770 is a rare classic and a unique vehicle. It may not be the fastest car on the street, but it’s ready to be used on the water as well and drives like a motorboat.

programme.title: S01 : E02 MG TC - Classic Ride
programme.desc: The MG TC is a sporty, but also extremely spartan car with technology from the late 1940s. We accompanied the owner of a MG TC on his way to pass the TÜV, the German technical certification test.

programme.title: S03 : E62 Auction Classics - Classic Ride
programme.desc: Nowadays the gull-winged classic DeLorean is an automotive investment. Also: 100 dream cars under the hammer at a classic car auction in Switzerland. And: modern classics with investment potential like the Mercedes 190E 2.3 16V.

programme.title: S02 : E41 Vintage Cars Worldwide - Classic Ride
programme.desc: In Thailand a Mercedes 190 SL and other souped-up classics take part in the Bangkok Classic Car Ride. Plus: an Oldsmobile convertible on Venezuela's most beautiful island. And: classic cars from the US as a tourist attraction in Cuba.

programme.title: S01 : E12 Animal-like Cars - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: In Los Angeles, Dean Malay put the Hollywood appeal of the Volkswagen Beetle Convertible to the test. Also: at the BMW Design Night the Bavarian manufacturer showcased its newest creations. And: the Stuck brothers with the Lexus IS-F at the test track.

programme.title: S01 : E07 To the Top! - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: The Audi Sport Quattro S1 was a rally legend. We checked how the company's series vehicle A1 Quattro fares in comparison. Also: the Stuck brothers take the Ford Focus ST to the test track. And: the spacey, but cute electric microcar Renault Twizy.

programme.title: S01 : E33 Pickups - 4x4
programme.desc: In Europe pickups are mainly used commercially. In the US these trucks are as common as SUVs. We compared the Volkswagen Amarok to the Toyota Hilux. Also: current US pickups, the Chevrolet Colorado and GMC's Sierra and Canyon.

programme.title: S01 : E24 Tuned SUVs - 4x4
programme.desc: SUVs usually are rather impressive right out of the factory, but there are many tuning and customizing options. In this episode we present Kelleners BMW X5, the Mercedes Brabus B63 and the Porsche Cayenne tuned by Techart.

programme.title: S01 : E33 Eurocopter - Made in ...
programme.desc: The Eurocopter EC 135 is the most successful and best-selling helicopter in the world and a multi-talent. Whether as a VIP shuttle, in air rescue or for the police. This all-rounder is even used for military tasks.

programme.title: S01 : E23 Unimog - Made in ...
programme.desc: It is a synonym and a touchstone for four-wheel drive movement. It is the symbol for quality of commercial vehicle constructions worldwide. Mercedes-Benz manufactured for the 60th birthday a new Unimog.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Ferruccio Lamborghini - Motorheads
programme.desc: In 1964, Ferruccio Lamborghini set himself the goal to build the best sports cars in the world, a bold move, being located only a few kilometers from Ferrari.

programme.title: S01 : E06 Alois Ruf - Motorheads
programme.desc: Alois Ruf jest założycielem małej, ale znanej firmy produkującej samochody w Bawarii, która specjalizuje się w budowie własnej wizji drogowych super samochodów sportowych na podstawie nadwozi Porsche.

programme.title: S01 : E35 Offroad Minis - 4x4
programme.desc: Small 4x4's are on the rise, as it doesn't need to be size that matters when it comes to having fun in the city or off-road. We take a look at mini SUVs, the Fiat's 500 X, the Cross Polo and Cross up! by Volkswagen and BMW's X1 XDrive.

programme.title: S01 : E18 Land Rover Special - 4x4
programme.desc: The Land Rover Defender is one of the oldest offroad car models. We took a look at this iconic vehicle and 70 years of Land Rover history. Also: we took the Range Rover Evoque, the most recent model of the British brand, to the legendary Silk Road.

programme.title: S02 : E47 Close to the ground - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: In their 4 series BMW took into account that sporty vehicles need a low center of gravity. In the manufacturer's range of vehicles this model is closest to the asphalt. We compared the BMW 435i and Porsche's Cayman S and took a look at the Alfa Romeo 4C.

programme.title: S02 : E49 Athletes on stilts - Power SUVs - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: Since the rising popularity of SUVs compact models have become a new trend, so the manufacturers started offering more models and pushing their performance. We took a look at the competitors Audi RS Q3, Mercedes-AMG GLA 45 and Porsche Macan Turbo.

programme.title: S01 : E32 Stereotypes on Two Wheels - Motocicletas
programme.desc: Scooters, stereotypes on two wheels? It doesn't always have to be a classic Vespa! We take a look at three alternatives: Kymco's big scooter xciting 500 i that feels like riding on a sofa, Piaggio's three-wheeler MP3 500 with two front wheels that promises more dynamic driving pleasure and the powerful electric scooter e-max from China.

programme.title: S01 : E38 Trikes - Motocicletas
programme.desc: Whether taking it easy and cruising, or firing it up and drifting - trikes, scooters and three-wheeled bike conversions all have their own charm and driving dynamics, especially the trikes. We take a closer look at four rather exotic motorcycles: the Rewaco RF1 Turbo, Piaggio's MP3 and bike conversions for the Suzuki 800 Intruder and the Triumph Rocket III Touring.

programme.title: S01 : E19 Fiat Dino - Classic Ride
programme.desc: The Fiat Dino Spider is one of the most beautiful cabriolets of the 1960s. Its impeccable design was created by Pininfarina, and only 525 units were built. Under its hood growls a Ferrari V6 engine.

programme.title: S02 : E45 50 Years Corvette Stingray - Classic Ride
programme.desc: 1963 saw the launch of the Chevrolet Corvette Stingray, the brand's answer to established sports car models by Jaguar, Maserati and others. Many consider it to be the most exciting sports car of all time. We pay tribute to this classic.

programme.title: S03 : E79 Classic Technology Carriers - Classic Ride
programme.desc: We followed the restoration of the unique Bayer K67 research vehicle, the first all-plastic car in the world, developed in 1967 by the pharmaceutical giant Bayer.

programme.title: S03 : E78 Iconic Racing Classics - Classic Ride
programme.desc: Cars like the Ford GT 40, the Jaguar D-Type or the Mercedes 300 SL wrote history on the race track and now break records at auctions. A sumptuously restored 300 SL will start at the most famous classic car rally in the world, the Mille Miglia.

programme.title: S01 : E22 Cruising - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: We explored how the Z4 Roadster feels as a cabriolet. Also: the small company Boom Trikes Automotive have become Europe's leading trike manufacturer. And: cruising through Los Angeles in a Volkswagen Beetle convertible.

programme.title: S02 : E29 Diesel Engines - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: It's all about Diesel this time. We compared the BMW 120d and the 125i. In addition: Audi's diesel-hybrid model R18 e-tron quattro dominated the endurance race in Le Mans. And: the diesel-powered Jaguar XF Sport Brake.

programme.title: S01 : E96 Red Bull Show Run - Supercoches
programme.desc: Red Bull takes a Formula One car on a city tour to promote the New Jersey Grand Prix. Also: Bentley proves that a V8 engine can also set elegant accents. And: McLaren presents the MP4-12 C Spider.

programme.title: S01 : E81 Porsche Cayman R - Supercoches
programme.desc: Not only Porsche fans will like the sportiest Cayman model. Also: with the Juke-R, Nissan combined a GT-R sports car and a crossover. And: the BMW G-Power is the fastest station wagon on this planet.

programme.title: S01 : E04 The Graduate - Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: A vehicle jumps at full speed over four cars, which explode one after the other. It’s a matter of precision and timing for the Stunt Heroes. Also, up-and-coming stuntwoman Tina has to prove her skills.

programme.title: S01 : E05 The Very First Time - Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: The team is shooting a car rollover. Stunt coordinator Carl wants to go all out. He adds an exciting shootout to the mix. Also, he has a surprise for his boss. During the rollover he wants him to sit in the passenger seat, for the very first time.

programme.title: S01 : E15 Episode 15 - Trackmasters
programme.desc: We present the highlights of last week. The 24 hour race was exciting, as usual. In addition, we explored the 'Strong Man Run' and took a look at the tourist drivers

programme.title: S01 : E19 Episode 19 - Trackmasters
programme.desc: The roaring sounds of engines and exhausts usually dominate the Nuerburgring, but we focused on something a bit quieter this time. How about taking part in a 15 mile bike ride around the ring, or perhaps a 16 mile run?

programme.title: S03 : E193 Open Air Feeling - Supercoches
programme.desc: The Mercedes-AMG C43 was supposed to act as the entry-level model to the brand's cabriolet world. With the 718 Boxster, Porsche offers a convertible at a competitive price as well.

programme.title: S02 : E109 Hot Supercars - Supercoches
programme.desc: Aston Martin V8 Vantage, Porsche 918 Spyder, Bentley Mulsanne, Audi R8 V10 or Bugatti Veyron Grand Sport Super Vitesse. These cars aren't really comparable as each vehicle is unique in its elegance and performance.

programme.title: S01 : E84 Kelleners KS1 RS - Supercoches
programme.desc: The BMW One M Coupe from the former race-driver Ralf Kelleners: the KS1 RS is one of the highlights in 2012. Also: another big score from Porsche, the beautiful 911 cabriolet. And: the Bentley Continental GT V8 is a dream car.

programme.title: S01 : E29 Enduro Park Hechlingen - Motocicletas
programme.desc: The BMW Enduro Park Hechlingen in Bavaria offers off-road driving pleasure both for beginners and pros alike on 26 hectares. We take a look at what this exciting place has to offer for enduro enthusiasts. Also: what does the inexpensive Hyosung ST 700 i from South Korea have to offer? And: the big-wheeled scooter from Taiwan, the Kymco People GT 300i.

programme.title: S01 : E30 Triumph Thunderbird - Motocicletas
programme.desc: The parallel twin-cylinder Triumph Thunderbird. Is the powerful 1.6 litre bike able to gain a foothold outside of the British Isles? Also: Harley-Davidson's black chopper Sportster 883 Iron, a starter bike for purists. And: Bike & Music, a spectacle for motorbike and stunt enthusiasts at Europe's biggest motorway rest area in Geiselwind, Germany.

programme.title: S01 : E19 Episode 19 - Trackmasters
programme.desc: The roaring sounds of engines and exhausts usually dominate the Nuerburgring, but we focused on something a bit quieter this time. How about taking part in a 15 mile bike ride around the ring, or perhaps a 16 mile run?

programme.title: S01 : E14 Episode 14 - Trackmasters
programme.desc: The fourth race of the VLN season is usually regarded as a dress rehearsal for the 24-hour race. For the top teams and best drivers it is the last opportunity for a really thorough test.

programme.title: S02 : E38 Scrapyard Gold - Classic Ride
programme.desc: Nie jest zbyt niezwykłe, aby znaleźć ukryte skarby motoryzacyjnej historii w doskonałym stanie w stodołach lub na złomowiskach. Także: MGC GT Sebring, który został zbudowany na wyścig 12 godzin Sebring.

programme.title: S03 : E71 Mobility in Eastern Europe - Classic Ride
programme.desc: In the 1950s, companies like Tatra from Czechoslovakia introduced advanced, even pioneering automobiles. The clientele was exclusive, which is why now these streamlined cars are big rarities. We tracked down the owner of a 1937 Tatra T87.

programme.title: S02 : E51 Open Air Concert - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: As an homage to driving top-down we took a look at three of the most beautiful convertibles. The animalistic sound of the Audi S3 convertible's 4-cylinder is astonishing. But what about the Nissan 370 Z Roadster? Or Porsche's Boxster GTS?

programme.title: S01 : E17 Topless on the road - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: Convertibles suggest to the feeling of freedom while driving a car. We took a look at what Opel's Cascada and Adam convertible models had to offer. Also: what does the BMW 3 series Gran Turismo have in common with its bigger brother from the 5 series?

programme.title: S02 : E124 Special: 24h of Le Mans - Track Days - Supercoches
programme.desc: Two weeks before the start of the 24 hours of Le Mans, all teams are busy testing their cars on the traditional long distance track in France. Bad weather, accidents and a lot of tension, we documented the official test days in 2013.

programme.title: S03 : E190 V8 Power - Supercoches
programme.desc: We took a look at Mercedes-Benz's first convertible model in their S-class. Also: for the Chevrolet Camaro's 50th anniversary in 2016 the brand released the sixth generation of their classic. And: a mountain cruise with the Corvette C7 convertible.

programme.title: S01 : E12 Episode 12 - Trackmasters
programme.desc: Once again it was time for the VLN Endurance Racing Championship. While the drivers were doing their test laps, we had a look behind the scenes and explored what went on in the pit lanes.

programme.title: S01 : E16 Episode 16 - Trackmasters
programme.desc: In this episode we invite you to witness the progress of driver Uwe Nittle as he got ready for qualifying at the Truck Grand Prix.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Chevy Camaro vs Mercedes SLS AMG - Pon tu coche en TV
programme.desc: Mylene Gomera and Saif Hattawi invite car freaks from the Middle East to show off their souped-up vehicles on the "Walk" at Jumeirah Beach in Dubai. In this episode, a Chevrolet Camaro competes against a Mercedes SLS AMG.

programme.title: S01 : E02 BMW X5 vs Mercedes SLK 230 - Pon tu coche en TV
programme.desc: If you like souped-up and luxuriously equipped vehicles, Jumeirah Beach in Dubai is the place to be. There, the cars are judged and there is also something to win. This episode features a BMW X5 and a Mercedes SLK 230.

programme.title: S03 : E160 Road Stars - Supercoches
programme.desc: The Silvretta Hochalpenstrasse in Austria is the ideal playground for the lightweight power packs Lotus Elise and Roding Roadster. Also: the elegant but still very powerful Porsche 911 Targa 4S.

programme.title: S02 : E106 Porsche to the Max - Supercoches
programme.desc: The Techart Grand GT by Porsche's house tuner is a souped-up Panamera. But the off-the-shelf GTS model also has its treats. Patrick Simon took this monster to the track. In addition: Ruf's anniversary model RT 35. And: the 911 Carrera 4.

programme.title: S01 : E05 BMW X6M vs Nissan Patrol - Pon tu coche en TV
programme.desc: At Jumeirah Beach in Dubai, car owners can have their souped-up vehicles judged in three categories and win an overnight stay at the Sofitel Hotel. This time, a BMW X6M, a Ford F250 and a Nissan Patrol are in the running.

programme.title: S02 : E119 Open-top Top Dog - Supercoches
programme.desc: A cruise over the Alps to Italy in a Maserati GranCabrio MC. In addition: a Brit with a fiery temperament, the Jaguar XK-RS convertible with 550 hp. And: Mercedes AMG's SL models, uncompromising performance.

programme.title: S01 : E08 Lexus GSF vs McLaren MP4-12C - Pon tu coche en TV
programme.desc: The competition for the coolest souped-up cars in the Middle East continues. The prize is an overnight stay for two at the Sofitel Jumeirah Beach. This time, the spotlight is on a Lexus GSF, a Ford Mustang and a McLaren MP4-12C.

programme.title: S01 : E07 Mercedes SLS vs Audi R8 - Pon tu coche en TV
programme.desc: Mylene Gomera and Saif Hattawi once again invite the owners of the most extraordinary cars to Dubai, where they award points for speed, style and sound. This time, they will be joined by a limited edition Mercedes SLS and an Audi R8.

programme.title: S01 : E19 Episode 19 - Trackmasters
programme.desc: The roaring sounds of engines and exhausts usually dominate the Nuerburgring, but we focused on something a bit quieter this time. How about taking part in a 15 mile bike ride around the ring, or perhaps a 16 mile run?

programme.title: S01 : E21 Episode 21 - Trackmasters
programme.desc: In this episode, we focused on Phoenix Racing, the successful team from the Eifel Region that rocked the DTM.

programme.title: S01 : E19 Fiat Dino - Classic Ride
programme.desc: The Fiat Dino Spider is one of the most beautiful cabriolets of the 1960s. Its impeccable design was created by Pininfarina, and only 525 units were built. Under its hood growls a Ferrari V6 engine.

programme.title: S02 : E60 French Classics - Classic Ride
programme.desc: French manufacturers have also built milestones in automotive history in the past, including lesser-known brands such as Delage and Talbot, but also vehicles from Peugeot, Renault and Citroen.

programme.title: S03 : E56 Turbo Diesel Power - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: We took a look at Audi's latest generation of TDI engines and their RS5 TDI Concept. In addition we compared the advantages and disadvantages of the two main fossil fuels for cars, gasoline and diesel. And: the 2014 Porsche Cayenne Diesel.

programme.title: S02 : E52 The big journey - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: The Mercedes-AMG E63 S is a wolf in sheep's clothing. This station wagon has more power than the Nissan GTR 'Godzilla'. Also: the Porsche Panamera GTS feels at home on the motorway and on the race track. And: Audi's powerful all-purpose executive car RS6.

programme.title: S01 : E73 McLaren MP4 12C GT3 - Supercoches
programme.desc: McLaren's MP4 12C GT3 is as fast as a Formula One car. We explored how this super sports car came to be. Also: the German company Mechatronik specializes in restoring rare and classic cars like the Mercedes W111.

programme.title: S01 : E74 Supercars of the Frankfurt Motor Show - Supercoches
programme.desc: We took a look at the IAA Frankfurt 2011 highlights, like the new Porsche 911, Mercedes' SLS AMG Roadster, the Bentley Continental Convertible, a 1,100 hp monster from Croatia and others.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Salto Mortale - Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: The Stunt Heroes face a new mission: performing a front-flip through the air with a stuntman behind the wheel of an estate wagon. Stuntmen Daniel and Lars display a brilliant fight choreography in some spectacular driving scenes.

programme.title: S01 : E03 The Remote Control - Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Stuntman Tobi operates an Artega GT at full speed via remote control. This is just a warm-up before the big stunt, in which he drives a car up a steep ramp at 68 mph. The question is: How high can remote-controlled cars fly?

programme.title: S01 : E10 Episode 10 - Trackmasters
programme.desc: Christian Menzel poprosił naszą prezenterkę Miriam o uczestnictwo w szkoleniu z zakresu bezpieczeństwa kierowców, podczas którego pokazał porady i sztuczki, co robić w sytuacjach awaryjnych.

programme.title: S01 : E11 Episode 11 - Trackmasters
programme.desc: Spring finally melted away the snow on the track and racing life returned to the Nuerburgring. Drivers with gasoline in their veins started chasing their cars around the ring again.

programme.title: S02 : E148 Drift! - Supercoches
programme.desc: The Subaru BRZ provides a great feel for the road. In addition: the BMW 235i RS has a great rear wheel performance. And: the Porsche Cayman GTS is a car that makes you smile from the moment you step on the gas.

programme.title: S01 : E80 Ferrari FF - Supercoches
programme.desc: The Ferrari Four, also called Ferrari FF, is the first four-wheel family car from Maranello. Also: the BMW M5 shines both as a family and business car. And: the Mercedes-Benz SL is a roadster drivers' dream.

programme.title: S01 : E31 BMW F 800 R - Motocicletas
programme.desc: Stunt world champion Chris Pfeiffer test drives the BMW F 800 R and explains why he is rather excited about the performance and handling of this robust and agile roadster. Also: a look behind the scenes of German helmet manufacturer Schuberth Helme's testing and development procedures. And: German actor Jürgen Vogel puts his new Ducati 1198 SP to the test at the Nürburgring.

programme.title: S01 : E40 Harley Sportster 1972 - Motocicletas
programme.desc: Harley-Davidson add three additions to their model range of bikes: the motorized wheelie bike Sportster 72, the versatile Switchback Dyna, and the bad-boy ride „Softail Slim“. Also: two German bikers take a dusty adventure ride through Mexico on their BMW's. And: the Triumph Speedmaster, the British answer to Harley-Davidson's cruiser.

programme.title: S01 : E21 Episode 21 - Trackmasters
programme.desc: In this episode, we focused on Phoenix Racing, the successful team from the Eifel Region that rocked the DTM.

programme.title: S01 : E12 Episode 12 - Trackmasters
programme.desc: Ponownie nadszedł czas na Mistrzostwa Wytrzymałościowe VLN. Podczas gdy kierowcy wykonywali swoje testowe okrążenia, przyjrzeliśmy się kulisy i zbadaliśmy, co się działo w pit stopach.

programme.title: S03 : E162 Plug and Drive Deluxe - Supercoches
programme.desc: W 2014 roku Mercedes-Benz zaprezentował swój pierwszy hybrydowy samochód plug-in, model S500. W przypadku Bentleya silnik V8 oznacza zmniejszenie rozmiarów. Zbadaliśmy model Flying Spur marki z mniejszym silnikiem. A także: szósta generacja Maserati Quattroporte.

programme.title: S03 : E165 Tracktools - Supercoches
programme.desc: Do you want to feel like a racing driver without being limited to a race track? If so, the British manufacturer Radical is the right choice, as the company builds race cars with road approval. Their RXC is a powerful and agile racer.

programme.title: S01 : E88 Mercedes-AMG G63 - Supercoches
programme.desc: Kierowca wyścigowy Karim Al-Azhari przedstawia swój ulubiony samochód, Forda GT. Ponadto: prawdziwy potwór na drodze, Mercedes-AMG G63. A także: wizja BMW dotycząca elektrycznych samochodów z otwartym dachem, koncept i8 Spyder.

programme.title: S01 : E20 The Ugliest Cars - Top 10 Show
programme.desc: The world of automobiles is also full of contrasts. There are fast and slow, beautiful and less beautiful models. We present our top 10 ugliest cars in the world.

programme.title: S01 : E29 The Very Best Car Nicknames - Top 10 Show
programme.desc: Finding the right name for a car model often poses a challenge for the manufacturers' marketing departments. We take a look at our Top 10 of the best car names.

programme.title: S01 : E05 BMW X6M vs Nissan Patrol - Pon tu coche en TV
programme.desc: At Jumeirah Beach in Dubai, car owners can have their souped-up vehicles judged in three categories and win an overnight stay at the Sofitel Hotel. This time, a BMW X6M, a Ford F250 and a Nissan Patrol are in the running.

programme.title: S01 : E07 Mercedes SLS vs Audi R8 - Pon tu coche en TV
programme.desc: Mylene Gomera and Saif Hattawi once again invite the owners of the most extraordinary cars to Dubai, where they award points for speed, style and sound. This time, they will be joined by a limited edition Mercedes SLS and an Audi R8.

programme.title: S02 : E120 When Sports Meets Indulgence - Supercoches
programme.desc: Luxury class grand tourers with four doors. Porsche introduced their Panamera as a Plugin Hybrid or equipped with new turbo engines. BMW responded with their M6 Gran Coupe. German engineering at its finest.

programme.title: S02 : E132 Hypercars - Supercoches
programme.desc: McLaren MP4 12C, Porsche 911 Turbo S i Mercedes SLS AMG GT to super sportowe samochody, które nie mają sobie równych. Wciskamy pedał w podłogę w tych ekscytujących i potężnych maszynach.

programme.title: S01 : E10 Episode 10 - Trackmasters
programme.desc: Christian Menzel asked our presenter Miriam to participate in a driver safety training where he showed tips and tricks on what to do in emergency situations.

programme.title: S01 : E11 Episode 11 - Trackmasters
programme.desc: Wiosna w końcu stopiła śnieg na torze, a życie wyścigowe powróciło na Nürburgring. Kierowcy z benzyną w żyłach znów zaczęli gonić swoje samochody po torze.

programme.title: S02 : E21 Fire! - Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: W tym odcinku Stunt Heroes robi się gorąco. Kaskader Paul zostanie pochłonięty przez płomienie, gdy wszystko wokół niego wybuchnie w tej niebezpiecznej akcji z ogniem. Zespół Action Concept starannie przygotowuje się do tej gorącej sceny.

programme.title: S02 : E28 Alarm in the gravel pit - Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Bohaterowie kaskaderzy przekształcili żwirownię w swoje plac zabaw do kaskaderki. Tym razem motocykl bez kierowcy skacze przez rampę, testowany jest katapult dla ludzi, a w scenie walki próbowane jest nowe uderzenie przewrotne.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Chevy Camaro vs Mercedes SLS AMG - Pon tu coche en TV
programme.desc: Mylene Gomera i Saif Hattawi zapraszają miłośników samochodów z Bliskiego Wschodu do zaprezentowania swoich zmodyfikowanych pojazdów na "Walk" w Jumeirah Beach w Dubaju. W tym odcinku Chevrolet Camaro rywalizuje z Mercedesem SLS AMG.

programme.title: S01 : E02 BMW X5 vs Mercedes SLK 230 - Pon tu coche en TV
programme.desc: Jeśli lubisz luksusowe samochody o wysokich osiągach, Jumeirah Beach w Dubaju to idealne miejsce. Tam samochody są oceniane, a także można coś wygrać. W tym odcinku porównujemy BMW X5 i Mercedesa SLK 230.

programme.title: S02 : E118 Batman's Dreams: Supercars in Acceleration - Supercoches
programme.desc: Konfrontacja kabrioletów, Nissan 370 Z w porównaniu do Porsche Boxster S. A także: ekskluzywny jednorazowy supersamochód wysokiej wydajności Maybach Exelero. I: marzenie o supersamochodzie, pojazd superlatyw, Bugatti Veyron Vitesse.

programme.title: S02 : E144 Lifestyle SUVs - Supercoches
programme.desc: In Morocco, you can find the dream landscapes from 1001 nights. We took the Porsche Macan Turbo through the city of Marrakesh and its beautiful countryside. In addition: the BMW X 6M, one of the pioneers in the SUV coupe segment.

programme.title: S01 : E19 Fiat Dino - Classic Ride
programme.desc: The Fiat Dino Spider is one of the most beautiful cabriolets of the 1960s. Its impeccable design was created by Pininfarina, and only 525 units were built. Under its hood growls a Ferrari V6 engine.

programme.title: S02 : E60 French Classics - Classic Ride
programme.desc: French manufacturers have also built milestones in automotive history in the past, including lesser-known brands such as Delage and Talbot, but also vehicles from Peugeot, Renault and Citroen.

programme.title: S03 : E56 Turbo Diesel Power - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: We took a look at Audi's latest generation of TDI engines and their RS5 TDI Concept. In addition we compared the advantages and disadvantages of the two main fossil fuels for cars, gasoline and diesel. And: the 2014 Porsche Cayenne Diesel.

programme.title: S02 : E52 The big journey - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: The Mercedes-AMG E63 S is a wolf in sheep's clothing. This station wagon has more power than the Nissan GTR 'Godzilla'. Also: the Porsche Panamera GTS feels at home on the motorway and on the race track. And: Audi's powerful all-purpose executive car RS6.

programme.title: S01 : E73 McLaren MP4 12C GT3 - Supercoches
programme.desc: McLaren's MP4 12C GT3 is as fast as a Formula One car. We explored how this super sports car came to be. Also: the German company Mechatronik specializes in restoring rare and classic cars like the Mercedes W111.

programme.title: S01 : E74 Supercars of the Frankfurt Motor Show - Supercoches
programme.desc: We took a look at the IAA Frankfurt 2011 highlights, like the new Porsche 911, Mercedes' SLS AMG Roadster, the Bentley Continental Convertible, a 1,100 hp monster from Croatia and others.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Salto Mortale - Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: The Stunt Heroes face a new mission: performing a front-flip through the air with a stuntman behind the wheel of an estate wagon. Stuntmen Daniel and Lars display a brilliant fight choreography in some spectacular driving scenes.

programme.title: S01 : E03 The Remote Control - Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Stuntman Tobi operates an Artega GT at full speed via remote control. This is just a warm-up before the big stunt, in which he drives a car up a steep ramp at 68 mph. The question is: How high can remote-controlled cars fly?

programme.title: S01 : E10 Episode 10 - Trackmasters
programme.desc: Christian Menzel poprosił naszą prezenterkę Miriam o uczestnictwo w szkoleniu z zakresu bezpieczeństwa kierowców, podczas którego pokazał porady i sztuczki, co robić w sytuacjach awaryjnych.

programme.title: S01 : E11 Episode 11 - Trackmasters
programme.desc: Spring finally melted away the snow on the track and racing life returned to the Nuerburgring. Drivers with gasoline in their veins started chasing their cars around the ring again.

programme.title: S02 : E148 Drift! - Supercoches
programme.desc: Subaru BRZ zapewnia doskonałe wrażenia z jazdy. Dodatkowo: BMW 235i RS ma wspaniałe osiągi tylnego napędu. A: Porsche Cayman GTS to samochód, który wywołuje uśmiech od chwili, gdy naciśniesz gaz.

programme.title: S01 : E80 Ferrari FF - Supercoches
programme.desc: The Ferrari Four, also called Ferrari FF, is the first four-wheel family car from Maranello. Also: the BMW M5 shines both as a family and business car. And: the Mercedes-Benz SL is a roadster drivers' dream.

programme.title: S01 : E90 Techart Cayenne Turbo Magnum - Supercoches
programme.desc: Techart przekształca Porsche Cayenne Turbo w prawdziwego potwora o mocy ponad 600 KM. Ponadto: Nissan wystartuje w 24 godzinach Le Mans z samochodem przypominającym Batmobil. A także: BMW 6 serii Gran Coupe.

programme.title: S01 : E31 BMW F 800 R - Motocicletas
programme.desc: Stunt world champion Chris Pfeiffer test drives the BMW F 800 R and explains why he is rather excited about the performance and handling of this robust and agile roadster. Also: a look behind the scenes of German helmet manufacturer Schuberth Helme's testing and development procedures. And: German actor Jürgen Vogel puts his new Ducati 1198 SP to the test at the Nürburgring.

programme.title: S01 : E40 Harley Sportster 1972 - Motocicletas
programme.desc: Harley-Davidson add three additions to their model range of bikes: the motorized wheelie bike Sportster 72, the versatile Switchback Dyna, and the bad-boy ride „Softail Slim“. Also: two German bikers take a dusty adventure ride through Mexico on their BMW's. And: the Triumph Speedmaster, the British answer to Harley-Davidson's cruiser.

programme.title: S01 : E20 Episode 20 - Trackmasters
programme.desc: Na starym grand prix w Nürburgringu możesz na przykład zobaczyć Mercedesa S o mocy 160 koni mechanicznych, który zaprowadził Rudolfa Caracciolę do zwycięstwa w otwierającym wyścigu w 1927 roku.

programme.title: S01 : E21 Episode 21 - Trackmasters
programme.desc: In this episode, we focused on Phoenix Racing, the successful team from the Eifel Region that rocked the DTM.

programme.title: S01 : E07 Porsche Carrera RS - Classic Ride
programme.desc: In the early 1970s the Porsche Carrera RS was the fastest and most agile production sports car in Germany. Today the RS is a Porsche classic with highest acclaim.

programme.title: S03 : E82 Saalbach Classic 2014 - Classic Ride
programme.desc: At the 2014 Saalbach Classic rally 80 teams raced their automobile rarities through the Austrian Alps. In addition: rally legend Walter Röhrl in a Porsche 911 RSR at the Cologne-Ahrweiler rally. And: the infamous Group B vehicle category.

programme.title: S01 : E08 Ready for Action - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: Behind the scenes of some of the exciting stunts at Action Concept, the biggest action movie production company in Europe. Also: Johannes and Ferdinand Stuck with the BMW Alpina D5 Twin Turbo at the test track. And: the Volkswagen Up city car.

programme.title: S01 : E21 All New! - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: Following the Porsche 911's anniversary we take a look back at this iconic model's history. Also: the world's first series-produced plug-in hybrid with a diesel engine, the Volvo V60. And: safety measures in the car world, from seatbelts to crash tests.

programme.title: S01 : E05 BMW X6M vs Nissan Patrol - Pon tu coche en TV
programme.desc: At Jumeirah Beach in Dubai, car owners can have their souped-up vehicles judged in three categories and win an overnight stay at the Sofitel Hotel. This time, a BMW X6M, a Ford F250 and a Nissan Patrol are in the running.

programme.title: S01 : E07 Mercedes SLS vs Audi R8 - Pon tu coche en TV
programme.desc: Mylene Gomera and Saif Hattawi once again invite the owners of the most extraordinary cars to Dubai, where they award points for speed, style and sound. This time, they will be joined by a limited edition Mercedes SLS and an Audi R8.

programme.title: S02 : E120 When Sports Meets Indulgence - Supercoches
programme.desc: Luxury class grand tourers with four doors. Porsche introduced their Panamera as a Plugin Hybrid or equipped with new turbo engines. BMW responded with their M6 Gran Coupe. German engineering at its finest.

programme.title: S02 : E132 Hypercars - Supercoches
programme.desc: The Mc Laren MP4 12C, the Porsche 911 Turbo S and the Mercedes SLS AMG GT are super sports cars that are second to none. We put the pedal to the metal in these exciting and powerful driving machines.

programme.title: S01 : E10 Episode 10 - Trackmasters
programme.desc: Christian Menzel asked our presenter Miriam to participate in a driver safety training where he showed tips and tricks on what to do in emergency situations.

programme.title: S01 : E11 Episode 11 - Trackmasters
programme.desc: Spring finally melted away the snow on the track and racing life returned to the Nuerburgring. Drivers with gasoline in their veins started chasing their cars around the ring again.

programme.title: S02 : E21 Fire! - Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: It's getting hot in this episode of Stunt Heroes. Stuntman Paul will be engulfed by flames as everything around him blows up in this dangerous fire stunt. The Action Concept team carefully prepares for this heated scene.

programme.title: S02 : E28 Alarm in the gravel pit - Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: The Stunt Heroes turned a gravel quarry into their own stunt playground. This time, a motorbike without a driver flies over a ramp, a catapult for humans is tested and a new rollover punch is tried out in a fight scene.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Chevy Camaro vs Mercedes SLS AMG - Pon tu coche en TV
programme.desc: Mylene Gomera and Saif Hattawi invite car freaks from the Middle East to show off their souped-up vehicles on the "Walk" at Jumeirah Beach in Dubai. In this episode, a Chevrolet Camaro competes against a Mercedes SLS AMG.

programme.title: S01 : E02 BMW X5 vs Mercedes SLK 230 - Pon tu coche en TV
programme.desc: If you like souped-up and luxuriously equipped vehicles, Jumeirah Beach in Dubai is the place to be. There, the cars are judged and there is also something to win. This episode features a BMW X5 and a Mercedes SLK 230.

programme.title: S02 : E118 Batman's Dreams: Supercars in Acceleration - Supercoches
programme.desc: The clash of the convertibles, the Nissan 370 Z in comparison to Porsche's Boxster S. Also: the exclusive one-off high-performance sports car Maybach Exelero. And: a dream of a sports car, a vehicle of superlatives, the Bugatti Veyron Vitesse.

programme.title: S03 : E156 Sports SUVs - Supercoches
programme.desc: Three extraordinarily sporty SUVs are the Porsche Macan Turbo, the Mercedes GLA 45 AMG and the Audi RSQ3. Each of these is able to easily cope with each season of the year and, in regards to performance, could be mistaken for a sports car.

programme.title: S02 : E117 Million-Dollar Toys from the Middle East - Supercoches
programme.desc: The McLaren MP4 12C Spider, one of many high-performance sports cars featured at the Doha Motor Show in Qatar. Also: the creations of manufacturers like Lamborghini, Bertone or Porsche but also the first Arab super sports car, the Lykan HyperSport.

programme.title: S03 : E71 Mobility in Eastern Europe - Classic Ride
programme.desc: W latach 50. XX wieku firmy takie jak Tatra z Czechosłowacji wprowadziły zaawansowane, wręcz pionierskie automobily. Klientela była ekskluzywna, dlatego teraz te opływowe samochody są wielkimi rarytasami. Odnaleźliśmy właściciela Tatr T87 z 1937 roku.

programme.title: S02 : E31 Women and their Classic Cars - Classic Ride
programme.desc: A small group of car enthusiastic ladies offers resistance in the otherwise man dominated classic car world. One of them is Johanna. The 24-year-old loves her 1969 Corvette more than everything.

programme.title: S01 : E22 Cruising - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: We explored how the Z4 Roadster feels as a cabriolet. Also: the small company Boom Trikes Automotive have become Europe's leading trike manufacturer. And: cruising through Los Angeles in a Volkswagen Beetle convertible.

programme.title: S03 : E57 Lightweight Cars - El coche perfecto
programme.desc: BMW i8 był jednym z pierwszych samochodów sportowych z pewnym rodzajem zielonego wizerunku. Dodatkowo zabraliśmy dwa lekkie samochody sportowe, Lotus Elise i Roding Roadster, na jedną z najpiękniejszych alpejskich dróg.

programme.title: S02 : E20 SUV Brothers - 4x4
programme.desc: Three brothers from the same Volkswagen production platform: the Skoda Kodiaq provides room for seven people, the Volkswagen Tiguan is a bit more expensive but offers a broader range of engines, and Seat infuse the SUV segment with Spanish passion.

programme.title: S02 : E08 Totally Jeep - 4x4
programme.desc: In 2016, the readers of the German "Off Road" magazine once again awarded the Jeep Wrangler as their favourite 4x4. Also: at the "Meet'n'Jeep" Jeep enthusiasts drive their treasures through slush and mud. Also: test driving the Jeep Cherokee.

programme.title: S01 : E28 Blacktrail E-Bike - Motocicletas
programme.desc: The Blacktrail by PG Bikes is the fastest and lightest E-bike in the world, but also the most expensive. What's behind this exciting power package from Regensburg, Germany? Also: is BMW's new flagship bike, the K 1600 GT with 6 cylinders really worth its price and is it able to stand up to the competition by Honda, Kawasaki and Benelli?

programme.title: S01 : E31 BMW F 800 R - Motocicletas
programme.desc: Stunt world champion Chris Pfeiffer test drives the BMW F 800 R and explains why he is rather excited about the performance and handling of this robust and agile roadster. Also: a look behind the scenes of German helmet manufacturer Schuberth Helme's testing and development procedures. And: German actor Jürgen Vogel puts his new Ducati 1198 SP to the test at the Nürburgring.

programme.title: S01 : E73 McLaren MP4 12C GT3 - Supercoches
programme.desc: McLaren's MP4 12C GT3 is as fast as a Formula One car. We explored how this super sports car came to be. Also: the German company Mechatronik specializes in restoring rare and classic cars like the Mercedes W111.

programme.title: S01 : E74 Supercars of the Frankfurt Motor Show - Supercoches
programme.desc: We took a look at the IAA Frankfurt 2011 highlights, like the new Porsche 911, Mercedes' SLS AMG Roadster, the Bentley Continental Convertible, a 1,100 hp monster from Croatia and others.

programme.title: S04 : E05 Píldora de veneno - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Tras un arresto por drogas, Andy y Marlo están en cuarentena. Mientras, la 15 División entra en emergencia para sacar las drogas contaminadas antes de que un brote mortal se extienda.

programme.title: S04 : E06 Esqueletos - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Al denunciarse la desaparición de una joven, pronto descubren una posible conexión con uno de los casos más angustiosos. Contrarreloj, Gail debe afrontar sus temores para encontrarla.

programme.title: S04 : E07 Martes 13 - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Cuando unos huesos encontrados abren un caso de personas desaparecidas, Swarek se reúne con su antiguo mentor para resolver el caso. Swarek se fija en él y debe decidir si seguir sus pasos.

programme.title: S04 : E08 Para bien, para mal - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Todos, especialmente Andy, quieren un turno fácil para ir a la boda de Frank y Noelle. Pero las cosas se complican cuando secuestran un autobús con personas mayores y la novia desaparece.

programme.title: S04 : E09 Lo que perdí - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: La visita de Chris cambia cuando secuestran a su hijo al cuidado de Andy y Nick. Todos se unen para encontrarlo. Pero su vuelta no libra a Chris de una revelación impactante.

programme.title: S04 : E10 Estás aquí - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Una redada es el primer caso de homicidio de Traci y les obliga a trabajar horas extras. Swarek, Oliver, Chris y Dov van a la cabaña de Oliver para confesarse, reparar generadores y unirse.

programme.title: S04 : E11 Engaño - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Cuando se encuentran a un sospechoso pedófilo medio muerto, Andy descubre que Marlo lo ha investigado durante días. Andy y Swarek deben luchar para cubrir a Marlo y encontrar al agresor.

programme.title: S04 : E12 Bajo fuego - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Después de que disparen a Andy y Chloe, los agentes ven que son el objetivo de alguien con rencor. Deben continuar sirviendo y protegiendo mientras están en la línea de fuego.

programme.title: S04 : E13 Mira las estrellas - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Tras un ataque contra los agentes de la 15 División, Andy, Swarek y sus compañeros tienen que reunir la verdad sobre un crimen pasado para encontrar a Oliver Shaw y salvar su vida.

programme.title: S05 : E01 En un pestañeo - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Tras los sucesos traumáticos de la noche (Ep. 413), Andy y Dov intentan tranquilizarse en un restaurante abierto las 24 horas, pero un asalto imprevisto los pilla por sorpresa y fuera de servicio. Mientras, los cansados agentes de la División 15 intentan contener los daños colaterales bajo la vigilancia de un nuevo y duro inspector.

programme.title: S05 : E02 Por su cuenta - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Es un día de sorpresas: Oliver es ascendido a sargento en funciones y Andy debe entrenar a Duncan Moore, el nuevo recluta de la División 15. Pero cuando Andy y Duncan responden a un homicidio en una tienda de empeños, queda claro que el novato va a ser todo un desafío para Andy.

programme.title: S05 : E03 Los rompecorazones ganan dinero - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Se acerca la noche benéfica y el inspector Jarvis envía a los agentes de la División 15 a incautar cualquier cosa obtenida con dinero ilegal. Pero cuando Andy y Nick van a una casa de apuestas ilegal y consiguen una confesión un tanto turbia, Andy pide ayuda a Sam para descubrir quién miente, por qué miente, y dónde está escondido el dinero antes de que nadie salga herido.

programme.title: S05 : E04 Buscado - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Descubren a un jefe mafioso ejecutado tras un tiroteo en un edificio de apartamentos y la División 15 tiene que encontrar al asesino antes de que estalle una guerra de bandas. Mientras el asesino intenta encontrar al único testigo que puede relacionarlo con el crimen, Andy y su novato, Duncan, se enfrentan a una heroica prueba a vida o muerte.

programme.title: S05 : E05 De encubierto - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: La División 15 se infiltra en un club que podría ser la tapadera de una tienda de armas, pero el comportamiento errático de Chris y su preocupación por un traficante en concreto provocan las sospechas de Dov. Andy descubre que Duncan ha presentado acusaciones graves contra ella, pero decide ayudar a Sam en un caso de personas desaparecidas con un giro un tanto tenebroso.

programme.title: S05 : E06 Dos verdades y una mentira - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Los agentes de la División 15 intentan encontrar al asesino de Brian Gowdy y Andy Sam viajan hasta la penitenciaria de Millburn para entrevistar a varios reclusos. Todos tienen relación con el sospechoso principal, pero uno resulta ser Jay Swarek, el escurridizo padre de Sam.

programme.title: S05 : E07 Trato con el diablo - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Es un día caótico en comisaría y Oliver tiene que preparar a Andy para defenderse en la vista de la expulsión de Duncan, que es en dos horas. Pero cuando Duncan presenta unas pruebas que culpan directamente a Andy, Oliver deberá decidir si está dispuesto a comprometer su integridad profesional, y su amistad con Andy, para salvarla.

programme.title: S05 : E08 Estrategia de salida - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: La adicción de Chris se hace evidente cuando una inocente llamada en una casa obliga a Dov y Chris a investigar un sospechoso allanamiento. El hijo adolescente de las víctimas entra en una depresión a medida que los secretos familiares revelan los problemas de la familia, pero son Chris y Dov los que acaban luchando por sus vidas.

programme.title: S05 : E09 Día de mudanza - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: La División 15 es asignada a un programa de ayuda comunitario: “Día de mudanza”, para ayudar a los inquilinos a desalojar un complejo que va a ser demolido. Pero cuando Andy y Chloe encuentra a un hombre apalizado en un piso vacío, su investigación desvela una despiadada operación criminal más grande de lo que podían imaginar.

programme.title: S05 : E10 Fragmentos - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Duncan, el antiguo recluta de Andy, ha vuelto y quiere reconciliarse, algo para lo que ella no está preparada. Pero los sentimientos personales deben quedar de lado cuando una bomba explota en un aparcamiento del centro. Con la ciudad amenazada, los agentes de la División 15 trabajan contrarreloj para descubrir el origen de las amenazas y detener al sospechoso antes de que haya más heridos.

programme.title: S05 : E11 Eterno - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Los agentes de la División 15 intentan rastrear a TED MCDONALD (el terrorista del Ep. 510). Pero, tras detenerlo, descubren que Ted tiene más bombas preparadas para detonar y el reloj no se detiene…

programme.title: S05 : E12 Ventanas abiertas - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Un mes después de la explosión en la sala de pruebas (Ep. 511), Andy y Sam regresan al trabajo después de unas muy necesarias vacaciones. Pero cuando un intruso ataca a Andy en casa de Traci, la Unidad de Delitos Sexuales se hace cargo del caso a su manera, y la División 15 deberá decidir si toman cartas en el asunto.

programme.title: S05 : E13 Familia perfecta - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy se plantea su futuro con Sam tras la sorprendente noticia de que Marlo está embarazada con su bebé (Ep. 512). Pero la idea de una familia perfecta de Andy cambia radicalmente cuando conoce a un descontrolado adolescente que necesita ser protegido de su conservadora familia.

programme.title: S05 : E14 Levantamiento - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Hay un motín en un centro penitenciario para mujeres mientras Andy, Juliet, Nick y Gail están allí para trasladar a varias prisioneras. Los cuatro acaban separados en una cárcel confinada, y Andy y Juliet quedan atrapadas con una mujer desesperada por demostrar su inocencia.

programme.title: S05 : E15 Soltar - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: El hermano desaparecido de Nick llega con nueva información sobre alguien de su trágico pasado y Nick intenta encontrarlo por su cuenta. Pero Juliet no lo pierde de vista y Nick se ve obligado a contarle los secretos de su pasado.

programme.title: S05 : E16 Un verdadero caballero - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Traci no aparece para su primera redada y la División 15 teme que un infame traficante de armas la haya secuestrado. Pero cuando Andy descubre que el violador en serie que no atraparon (Ep. 512) ha vuelto, todos deberán colaborar para encontrar a Traci. Mientras, Traci se enfrenta a su captor e intenta escapar antes de que sea tarde.

programme.title: S05 : E17 Cuadrangular - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: La relación de Gail con su hermano Steve Peck es puesta prueba mientras buscan al pistolero que ha disparado desde un coche en un partido de béisbol comunitario. Mientras, Swarek planea una escapada con Andy a la cabaña de Gavin, pero la cosa acaba fatal de todas las maneras posibles menos una.

programme.title: S05 : E18 El mejor - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy y Sam se sorprenden al descubrir que Oliver es el principal sospechoso de la investigación de Asuntos Internos sobre la corrupción en la División 15. Y lo que es peor, solo tienen hasta la noche para encontrar a Chris Klem, el vendedor de explosivos desaparecido, y limpiar el nombre de Oliver antes de que cargue con todo.

programme.title: S05 : E19 Prueba de integridad - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Oliver es el principal sospechoso de la bomba en la sala de pruebas de la División 15 y Andy, Dov, Gail y Nick traman un peligroso plan que podría acabar con sus carreras para demostrar que el comisionado Alonso Santana es corrupto. Mientras, Traci sigue a Steve Peck con la esperanza de calmar sus temores sobre su relación con el atentado.

programme.title: S05 : E20 Treinta y dos grados - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Mientras los agentes de la División 15 intentan pasar página tras el escándalo de corrupción, una ola de calor obliga a Jarvis a abrir la división al público para que puedan refrescarse. Andy ayudar a la embarazada Marlo a encontrar a una mujer que ha desaparecido tras una terapia en grupo, pero ni Andy ni Marlo están preparadas cuando la última se pone de parto.

programme.title: S05 : E21 Se separa la banda - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Ahora que ha llegado el bebé de Sam y Marlo (Ep. 520), es evidente que nada podría haber preparado a Andy para este momento. Así que cuando Juliet le ofrece a Andy la oportunidad de participar en una misión encubierta de cuatro meses, esta empieza a pensárselo. Mientras, Jarvis revela la sorprendente noticia de que la División 15 se reestructurará tras el escándalo de corrupción.

programme.title: S05 : E22 74 epifanías - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: La reestructuración de la División 15 está al caer y la boda de Andy y Sam llega en el momento justo para celebrar una última fiesta todos juntos. Pero cuando un autoestopista hace desviar a Andy y acaba en una carretera sin salida, con un hombre moribundo y sin modo de pedir ayuda ni de avisar a Sam de que no ha huido, ¿será capaz de salvar la vida al hombre? ¿Llegará a tiempo a su boda?

programme.title: S01 : E01 Pintura fresca - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: El triunfo se convierte en humillación. Una operación de alto riesgo se tuerce cuando la agente novata Andy McNally pilla a uno de los suyos frustrando una operación encubierta.

programme.title: S01 : E02 Mercurio en retroceso - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Mientras los demás novatos persiguen a un preso fugado, Swarek le cuenta a Andy sus hazañas encubiertas del pasado. Juntos persiguen a un informante desaparecido en peligro y saltan chispas.

programme.title: S01 : E03 Noche de pelea - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy debe saltarse el protocolo para ganarse la confianza de una víctima de abusos a la que el sistema ha defraudado. Mientras, los demás novatos se pelean en "La Noche de Combate".

programme.title: S01 : E04 Señales cruzadas - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy se infiltra como prostituta. La tensión se dispara cuando Dov pone en peligro la vida de una informante y Andy tiene que infiltrarse en un arriesgado negocio de armas para salvarla.

programme.title: S01 : E05 A plena luz del día - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Un allanamiento de morada en un barrio de lujo moviliza a todos los novatos, pero una vez despejado el lugar, es Andy quien se queda sola y se enfrenta a un ladrón muy volátil.

programme.title: S01 : E06 A prueba de balas - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Un accidente de tráfico fatal revela una verdad impactante, y el romance de Andy y el inspector Luke Callaghan se complica cuando discrepan sobre el manejo de un testigo de asesinato.

programme.title: S01 : E07 Con los nervios de punta - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Una ola de calor causa estragos en la ciudad, que se multiplican ante el temor de un violador en serie que anda suelto. Mientras, un apagón obliga a Andy a enfrentarse a un cruel agresor.

programme.title: S01 : E08 Cuadro de honor - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy y Chris investigan una paliza en un club. Cuando las pistas apuntan a un policía, deben tomar una decisión que pondrá a prueba su lealtad al cuerpo y puede hacer peligrar sus carreras.

programme.title: S01 : E09 La novia del año - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Chris y Gail ven un coche cuya matrícula coincide con una alerta ámbar de una niña de 9 años. Mientras buscan al conductor, el interrogatorio a los padres revela pruebas inquietantes.

programme.title: S01 : E10 Big Nickel - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: La tensión entre Andy y Swarek es máxima, pero deben dejar a un lado sus sentimientos cuando el transporte de un preso fallido los obliga a buscar al fugitivo.

programme.title: S01 : E11 Para servir o proteger - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: El padre de Andy, Tommy, expolicía, confiesa que pudo haber cometido un delito estando ebrio. Andy profundiza en el caso y se enfrenta a la posibilidad de enviar a su padre a la cárcel.

programme.title: S01 : E12 El Día del Juicio Final - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Son las evaluaciones de rendimiento, o Día del Juicio Final. ¿Entregará Andy su placa antes de que el sargento Frank dé su opinión? El asesinato de una desconocida conmociona a Andy.

programme.title: S02 : E01 Mariposas - Rookie Blue

programme.title: S02 : E08 Monstruo - Rookie Blue

programme.desc: La 15 sigue conmocionada por la muerte de uno de los suyos. Tras robarles información confidencial, intentan resolver varios casos y buscar a un informante posiblemente descubierto.

programme.title: S03 : E12 Cada uno de nosotros - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: La 15 vuelve a sus orígenes. Una amenaza de muerte a un sacerdote lleva a Andy y Nick a un capo de la droga, y se dan cuenta de que están en una zona de guerra con una relación sorprendente.

programme.title: S03 : E13 Yo, nunca - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: La 15 busca a un secuestrador de niños, pero descubren que se ha llevado a otra víctima. El instinto de Andy se confirma al localizarlos y descubre a Sam Swarek en un mortal enfrentamiento.

programme.title: S04 : E01 Sorpresas - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Tras seis meses de encubierto, la operación de Andy y Nick va mal cuando desaparecen. Un arresto pone a Sam Swarek y los otros agentes en la misión de investigación convertida en rescate.

programme.desc: Al volver, Andy debe trabajar con Swarek para rastrear a un exconvicto decidido a recuperar su antigua vida. Andy se da cuenta de cuánto ha cambiado desde que dejó su antigua vida.

programme.desc: Andy se asocia con la nueva novia de Swarek. Se encuentran con una PEP (Persona Emocionalmente Perturbada) y sus diferencias son puestas a prueba y uno de ellos debe apretar el gatillo.

programme.desc: Al denunciarse la desaparición de una joven, pronto descubren una posible conexión con uno de los casos más angustiosos. Contrarreloj, Gail debe afrontar sus temores para encontrarla.

programme.title: S04 : E10 Estás aquí - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Una redada es el primer caso de homicidio de Traci y les obliga a trabajar horas extras. Swarek, Oliver, Chris y Dov van a la cabaña de Oliver para confesarse, reparar generadores y unirse.

programme.title: S04 : E11 Engaño - Rookie Blue

programme.desc: Después de que disparen a Andy y Chloe, los agentes ven que son el objetivo de alguien con rencor. Deben continuar sirviendo y protegiendo mientras están en la línea de fuego.

programme.title: S04 : E13 Mira las estrellas - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Tras un ataque contra los agentes de la 15 División, Andy, Swarek y sus compañeros tienen que reunir la verdad sobre un crimen pasado para encontrar a Oliver Shaw y salvar su vida.

programme.title: S05 : E01 En un pestañeo - Rookie Blue

Mientras, los cansados agentes de la División 15 intentan contener los daños colaterales bajo la vigilancia de un nuevo y duro inspector.

programme.title: S05 : E02 Por su cuenta - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Es un día de sorpresas: Oliver es ascendido a sargento en funciones y Andy debe entrenar a Duncan Moore, el nuevo recluta de la División 15. Pero cuando Andy y Duncan responden a un homicidio en una tienda de empeños, queda claro que el novato va a ser todo un desafío para Andy.

programme.title: S05 : E03 Los rompecorazones ganan dinero - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Se acerca la noche benéfica y el inspector Jarvis envía a los agentes de la División 15 a incautar cualquier cosa obtenida con dinero ilegal. Pero cuando Andy y Nick van a una casa de apuestas ilegal y consiguen una confesión un tanto turbia, Andy pide ayuda a Sam para descubrir quién miente, por qué miente, y dónde está escondido el dinero antes de que nadie salga herido.

programme.title: S05 : E04 Buscado - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Descubren a un jefe mafioso ejecutado tras un tiroteo en un edificio de apartamentos y la División 15 tiene que encontrar al asesino antes de que estalle una guerra de bandas. Mientras el asesino intenta encontrar al único testigo que puede relacionarlo con el crimen, Andy y su novato, Duncan, se enfrentan a una heroica prueba a vida o muerte.

programme.title: S05 : E05 De encubierto - Rookie Blue
programme.desc: La División 15 se infiltra en un club que podría ser la tapadera de una tienda de armas, pero el comportamiento errático de Chris y su preocupación por un traficante en concreto provocan las sospechas de Dov. Andy descubre que Duncan ha presentado acusaciones graves contra ella, pero decide ayudar a Sam en un caso de personas desaparecidas con un giro un tanto tenebroso.

programme.title: S05 : E06 Dos verdades y una mentira - Rookie Blue

programme.title: S05 : E07 Trato con el diablo - Rookie Blue

Pero cuando Duncan presenta unas pruebas que culpan directamente a Andy, Oliver deberá decidir si está dispuesto a comprometer su integridad profesional, y su amistad con Andy, para salvarla.

programme.title: S05 : E08 Estrategia de salida - Rookie Blue

El hijo adolescente de las víctimas entra en una depresión a medida que los secretos familiares revelan los problemas de la familia, pero son Chris y Dov los que acaban luchando por sus vidas.

programme.title: S05 : E09 Día de mudanza - Rookie Blue
